reason: My first question is always whether it's really tested, and here the lab is named and the report for my batch is on the page. At $24.99 with money back if I finish the box and don't like it, I'll try one box.
objection: I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I'm afraid I'll quit halfway. I also can't check that the report is real until the box arrives.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out not to match the batch number on the box, or the lab wasn't a real one I can look up, I'd drop it.
